properties.name: F05: 2 The Cottage to 1 The Cottage
properties.notes: 4-fibre single-mode cable. Route drawn by Nat over the aerial photo; exact line, depth and duct not surveyed.

properties.name: F06: 2 The Cottage to Ty Di rif
properties.notes: 1-fibre single-mode cable, one BiDi link to Ty Di rif. Route drawn by Nat over the aerial photo; exact line, depth and duct not surveyed.

properties.name: 1 The Cottage: LC wall box
properties.notes: Wall-mounted LC box with 2 LC connectors; both are spliced, to 2 of F05's 4 fibres. A duplex LC patch lead runs from it to 1 The Cottage's UniFi gateway (SFP).
properties.source: Nat (contents); position is the end of F05 as drawn; position confirmed accurate by Nat 2026-11-05

properties.name: 2 The Cottage: outdoor enclosure, 16-port LC patch box
properties.notes: Grey outdoor enclosure on the house wall with a 16-port LC patch box ('Llwynygorras Community'): ports 1-8 the 8-fibre cable from the woods, 9 to Ty Di rif, 12 to Llwyn Dewi, 13-16 to 1 The Cottage. Also holds 2 The Cottage's SFP media converter. Patching: LC1 to LC9 (Ty Di rif), LC6 to LC13 (1 The Cottage), LC7 to the media converter (2 The Cottage), LC8 to LC12 (Llwyn Dewi).
properties.source: Nat (photo 2026-11-05); position is the shared start of F05 and F06 as drawn

properties.name: Llwyn Dewi: LC wall box (indoors)
properties.notes: LC wall box labelled 'Llwyn-y-Gorras community fibre'. F07 (black single-fibre drop) comes up through the floor; a yellow LC patch lead goes to Llwyn Dewi's MikroTik router SFP. F07's route is not drawn yet.

properties.name: Barn front left manhole (MH01): CommScope splice closure
properties.notes: Inline closure with about 6 splice trays. F09 (yellow, labelled 40-core, to the barn rack) is spliced to F12 (greenhouse, 1 GH), F10 (treehouse, 2 TH) and F13 (workshop, 3 WS), each 8-fibre. Which fibres go where is not yet recorded.

properties.name: Ty Di rif: LC wall box
properties.notes: Wall-mounted LC box with 2 LC connectors; port 1 is spliced to F06's single fibre and patched to the SFP in Ty Di rif's MikroTik router. Port 2 is spare.
properties.source: Nat (contents); position is the end of F06 as drawn; position confirmed accurate by Nat 2026-11-05
